name: Ragnaros
source: [core: vmangos] Melee 1,999 to 2,650 a 2.8 s swing before armor: vmangos core (github.com/vmangos/core, db_latest db-4641790): creature_template, spell_template, the boss script, damage_multiplier 18.2. a 2006 Molten Core full clear from Blizzard's servers in WWS format (web.mit.edu/cat/project/WoW/MCDump200609/), hits after armor: 152 hits, 1,102 average after armor. Elemental Fire 20564: on every landed melee hit, 2,160 to 2,640 Fire and 600 Fire a second for 8 s (Wowhead confirms the duration), the log's hits 693 and ticks 172 average on a tank in fire resistance gear.
notes: Elemental Fire comes from landed hits only, so the sim gives it every 5 s on average (about 55% of 2.8 s swings land). Its DoT is 8 ticks of 600. Fire resistance from gear and buffs takes its share. Wrath of Ragnaros (every 25 to 30 s, 1,000 Fire and a knockback that wipes threat, so a second tank picks him up) and the submerge phase are left out: one tank's stint between knockbacks is what's scored.

healing.notes: A 40-player Molten Core raid's main tank: 4 healers at 400 HPS each on it in 2 s heals (800 a heal), a mix of paladins on Flash of Light rank 6 (about 600 at 400 healing power) and priests on Greater Heal rank 4 or downranked Heal. 1,600 HPS before overheal, about 2.4 times a pre-raid warrior's 650 DTPS here, the Classic Era Molten Core logs' ratio (wowsims/forever).
